        function TeleportSpawnMob(y)
            if typeof(y) == "table" then
                if #sharedState.value >= #y then
                    sharedState.value = {}
                    return
                end
                local value = DetectPartSpawnMob(DetectNameTablePart(y))
                if not value then
                    return
                end
                toTarget(value.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 60, 0))
                task.wait(0.5)
            else
                task.wait(0.5)
                local value = DetectPartSpawnMob(y, true)
                if value then
                    if (value.Position - Runtime.localPlayer2.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 100 or DetectMob(y) then
                        Instance.new("IntValue", value).Name = "Ignored"
                    end
                    toTarget(value.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 60, 0))
                else
                    DeleteIgnoredMobSpawn()
                end
            end
        end

        function QuestBoneAndkatakuri(y, inputValue)
            local value = getgenv().questpoint[y]
            if not value then
                CFrameQuest()
                task.wait(1.5)
                value = getgenv().questpoint[y]
                if not value then
                    return
                end
            end
            local humanoidRootPart, x = Runtime.localPlayer2.Character and Runtime.localPlayer2.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), Runtime.localPlayer2.Character and Runtime.localPlayer2.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoidRootPart then
                return
            end
            if not x then
                return
            end
            if (value.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 8 then
                if not (x.Health > 0) then
                    return
                end
                CommF:InvokeServer("StartQuest", y, inputValue)
                task.wait(0.5)
            else
                toTarget(value * CFrame.new(0, 4, 2), true)
            end
        end

        function DetectMobAura()
            local kind = typeof(Settings["Distance Farm Aura"])
            local distanceFarmAura
            if not (typeof(Settings["Distance Farm Aura"])) then
                distanceFarmAura = Settings["Distance Farm Aura"] or 300
            elseif (typeof(Settings["Distance Farm Aura"])) ~= "number" then
                distanceFarmAura = tonumber(Settings["Distance Farm Aura"]) or Settings["Distance Farm Aura"] or 300
            else
                distanceFarmAura = Settings["Distance Farm Aura"] or 300
            end
            local value, value2, value3 = pairs(game.Workspace.Enemies:GetChildren())
            local name = nil
            local b_1 = 2
            local nextEntry4 = createIterator(value, value2, value3)
            while true do
                local hasEntry16, entryKey16, entryValue12 = nextEntry4()
                if not hasEntry16 then
                    break
                end
                do
                    local value4 = entryValue12
                    while IsMobAlive(value4) do
                        local magnitude = (value4.HumanoidRootPart.Position - game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).magnitude
                        if magnitude < distanceFarmAura then
                            name = value4.Name
                            distanceFarmAura = magnitude
                            local hasEntry17, entryKey17, entryValue13 = nextEntry4()
                            if hasEntry17 then
                                value4 = entryValue13
                                continue
                            end
                            return name
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            return name
        end

        function CheckCDSkillTransformation(instance, inputValue)

                end
            end
        end

        function timeToSeconds(inputValue)
            local match, match2, value = inputValue:match("^(%d+):(%d+):(%d+)$")
            if not match then
                match2, value = inputValue:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
                match = 0
            end
            return tonumber(match) * 3600 + tonumber(match2) * 60 + tonumber(value)
        end

        function secondsToTime(inputValue)
            return string.format(
                "%d:%02d:%02d",
                math.floor(inputValue / 3600),
                math.floor(inputValue % 3600 / 60),
                inputValue % 60
            )
        end

-- STRONG FALLBACK BOOT
task.spawn(function()
    for i = 1, 10 do
        task.wait(1)
        print("[Banana] fallback tick", i, "T0=", getgenv().__BF_T0, "LOADED=", getgenv().__BF_LOADED)
        if getgenv().__BF_LOADED then
            print("[Banana] already loaded")
            return
        end
        if getgenv().__BF_T0 then
            print("[Banana] bootstrap started")
            return
        end
        -- try force
        pcall(function()
            if Features and Features.initializeSettings and not getgenv().__BF_T0 then
                print("[Banana] calling initializeSettings")
                Features.initializeSettings()
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if Features and Features.normalizeSettings then
                Features.normalizeSettings()
            end
        end)
    end
    print("[Banana] fallback gave up after 10s — check errors above")
end)


-- CLOSE LOADING UI IF STUCK
task.spawn(function()
    for i = 1, 30 do
        task.wait(1)
        if getgenv().__BF_LOADED then
            pcall(function()
                if getgenv().__BF_PROGRESS_CLOSE then getgenv().__BF_PROGRESS_CLOSE() end
            end)
            return
        end
        -- after 8s still not loaded, try to force progress and find UI
        if i == 8 or i == 15 or i == 25 then
            print("[Banana] still loading... tick", i, "stage=", getgenv().__BF_BOOT_STAGE)
            pcall(function()
                if getgenv().__BF_PROGRESS then getgenv().__BF_PROGRESS(math.min(i * 3, 99)) end
            end)
            -- try enable any hub-looking ScreenGui
            pcall(function()
                local hui = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
                for _, g in ipairs(hui:GetChildren()) do
                    if g:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                        local n = string.lower(g.Name)
                        if n:find("banana") or n:find("chuoi") or n:find("hub") or n:find("main") then
                            g.Enabled = true
                            print("[Banana] enabled gui", g.Name)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    print("[Banana] giving up wait for __BF_LOADED")
    pcall(function()
        if getgenv().__BF_PROGRESS_CLOSE then getgenv().__BF_PROGRESS_CLOSE() end
    end)
end)
